## MMIPS safety review

- [ ] Synthetic data only; no real family, victim, witness, subscriber, requester, moderator, investigative, or exact-location data used.
- [ ] No production credentials or secret values added.
- [ ] Scope is limited to the assigned task.
- [ ] No safety controls weakened to make tests pass.
- [ ] Human moderation remains mandatory before publication.
- [ ] Exact and sensitive locations remain private by default.
- [ ] Private submissions, requester information, moderator notes, audit details, authorization evidence, private images, and subscriber information remain non-public.
- [ ] No unverified accusations are published.

## Behavior, tests, and migrations

- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate tests.
- [ ] Consequential migrations include migration order and rollback or forward-fix instructions.
- [ ] WCAG 2.2 AA impact considered.
- [ ] Trauma-informed family-facing impact considered.
